text:
Ana (CS): Quick sync on ZephyrCloud dedicated bring-up. Quotas are provisioned but autoscale policy still needs a tweak. We have a renewal-facing demo next week so want to avoid any warmup jitter. Need a short plan and a load-window.
Priya (SRE): Got it. I saw the pool at 60% headroom in staging. Autoscale min=2 max=20 right now — we should tighten scale-in cooldowns.
Sam (CSE): Agree on cooldowns. For this workload burstiness is high, set cooldown to 45s and evaluation window to 90s?
Leo (ML Eng): That sounds reasonable. Also recommend enabling KV prefix caching for the few high-traffic prompts — reduces token work.
Ana (CS): Timeline: can SRE run a progressive shadow run tomorrow 09:00-10:30 PT? We'll mirror prod traffic at 30/60/100% for 20m each.
Priya (SRE): I can run it but need the load spec and endpoint. @Sam can you share the shadow harness and credentials?
Sam (CSE): Pushing load harness to the account repo now. Command to kick off: `./shadow_run.sh --profile zephyr --phases 30,60,100 --duration 1200`. I'll DM creds to Priya.
DeployBot: deploy/trigger accepted: shadow-run job queued (job id: sb-8246).
Priya (SRE): Starting the shadow run at 09:00. I'll watch CPU/GPU util, queue length, 95th/99th latency, and error rates. Will post metrics snapshots here.
Ana (CS): Thanks. Two risk items to track for renewal: 1) warmup latency spikes during the first 15m of burst, 2) perceived cost vs demo expectations. Let's capture logs for both.
Leo (ML Eng): I'll add a micro-eval set to detect generation regressions during the run. If quality dips >2% we abort and fallback to the smaller quantized variant.
Sam (CSE): Noted. Fallback policy: auto-route to `redwood-quant-v1` on >1% error or sustained 99p latency >2s for 5m.
Ana (CS): Perfect. After the run, let's meet 11:00 PT for a 20m debrief and finalize the autoscale policy for prod cutover.
Priya (SRE): On it. I'll post the run logs + grafana links in this thread when done. :thumbsup:
Ana (CS): Thanks team — really appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll prep the renewal talking points with these mitigations.
Sam (CSE): Will keep standby for any rollbacks.
Priya (SRE): Shadow run complete. Summary: no OOMs, cold-start latency peaked at 1.8s for the first few requests, 99p stabilized under 1.1s after 6m. Posting grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/zephyr/sb-8246
Ana (CS): Great — can you attach the raw run CSV and the small eval diff, @Leo?
Leo (ML Eng): Uploading now: https://files.internal/zephyr/shadow-sb-8246-eval.csv. Quality delta 0.6% (within threshold).
Ana (CS): That's reassuring. Next steps: tighten scale-in cooldown to 30s, keep scale-out as-is, enable KV caching; prepare runbook snippet for the renewal demo. I'll draft and share.
